_help: The changelog is generated from git history by scripts/changelog.mjs every time the site is published. Don't edit changelog.json by hand.

version: the major.minor version. Each publish that changes guide content or plugin rules adds the next patch number (2.0.1, 2.0.2, …). Change this to "2.1" or "3.0" for a bigger release; numbering restarts at .0.

Each change in a version is the commit's summary line, so write clear commit messages. Generic messages like "Update forms.md" become "Updated Forms". Put [skip changelog] in a commit message to leave it out.
ignoreCommits: commits that moved files around without changing content, so they don't reset page update dates.
history: hand-written notes for versions published before the changelog was automated.
lastUpdated: update dates for content whose earlier history happened before it moved into its own file.

changes: Initial snapshot of Style Guide 2.0 and its 31 sub-pages from the Confluence Design space.
Added the Glossary of approved product names, abbreviations, and preferred terms, compiled from the guide’s reference pages.
Added Standard Copy with the standard system error message and approved SMS compliance language.
Renamed the SMS compliance messages by program: MyHQ+ Activity Alerts opt-in, MyHQ+ two-factor opt-in, and BizHQ+ Activity Alerts opt-in.
Legal document names (Terms of Use, Terms and Conditions, Privacy Policy) are capitalized as proper nouns and must always be linked. Added them to the Glossary as a new Legal document type.
Button label length now depends on the button style: 3 words at most for buttons with a container, up to 5 for text-only buttons.
Phone numbers use (xxx) xxx-xxxx, or +1 (xxx) xxx-xxxx with a country code.
Quoted SMS keywords, like Reply “STOP” to opt out, are an approved use of quotation marks.
Launched the KUBRA Copy Audit Figma plugin, which checks Figma text against this guide.
